CustomField.description: Flags open High or Critical Cases that have not been updated in 48 or more hours.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT(IsClosed), OR( ISPICKVAL(Priority, 'High'), ISPICKVAL(Priority, 'Critical') ), (NOW() - LastModifiedDate) * 24 >= 48 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when this open Case has High or Critical priority and has not been updated in 48 or more hours.
CustomField.label: Needs Escalation
